capabilities: color sidebar folders automatically based on an A-Z sorted folder list
select from 18 color themes for dark and light mode
color sub-folders and files with an indicator for active files
increase color contrast with an accessibility mode
restart the color scheme for selected sub-folders
extras: README warns that colors are assigned by A-Z folder order, so colors may end up mixed because the file manager's custom ordering cannot be taken into account.
motivation: The author was not satisfied with the colored sidebar options currently available.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer has no built-in per-folder coloring, and existing colored-sidebar options require CSS tweaking or per-folder configuration.
summary: Sidebar colorizer that automatically assigns rainbow colors to sidebar folders and files from 18 selectable color themes.
